shots.intent: 在搜索列表用干净管身加一抹湿润膏体抢第一眼点击。
一秒把水润、好上手、轻透三层购买理由排给买家看。
shots.textZone: left third column, three stacked headline-plus-subline slots

shots.intent: 用涂前打底与涂后提亮两个留空步骤位建立使用直觉。
shots.textZone: left column, two stacked outlined circle slots holding 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 用同机位同光的干燥唇与上后水光唇做物证对比。
shots.textZone: two blank pill plates at the outer bottom corners holding 「{callout_3}」 and 「{callout_4}」

shots.intent: 用摊开膏体的湿润纹路证明水光质地而非油亮黏腻。
用仰拍管口与压纹管尾交代便携结构与出膏方式。
shots.textZone: one thin blank callout line along the right edge holding 「{callout_6}」

shots.intent: 一屏摊开可选色系与各自膏体色带，让买家自行挑选。
shots.textZone: left column, one blank pill tag per unit holding 「{callout_7}」 placeholders

shots.intent: 用留空对照表与三点指示行帮买家判断自己需要的类型。
shots.textZone: header band, left row-label column and blank cell slots, one headline placeholder 「{callout_8}」

shots.intent: 用整排陈列与空印章框收口信任，把主张位留给真实凭证。
shots.textZone: bottom band, one empty rounded seal frame plus one blank headline plate holding 「{callout_9}」

style.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF packshot field alternating with flat jelly-blush graphic panels #FDF2F0, #F9D9D7, #F8D7D5 and one deeper rose shelf field #F2BEBE; one flat colour field per screen, never a gradient or a random room
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line glyphs in charcoal-plum #3A2C30 seated in blank rounded chips and pill tags, plus three-dot indicator rows, no filled badge art
style.lightingSystem: bright soft high-key studio light, front-left key with wrap fill, 5400-5600K, low contrast, single-direction soft contact shadows, one small controlled specular on wet balm surfaces, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean glossy jelly lip-care ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white field #FFFFFF, jelly blush pink #F9D9D7, one accent #E23A52 and charcoal-plum text #3A2C30; neutral color temperature; one flat colour graphic field per screen, white for packshots and blush pink for story, variant and trust screens; bright soft high-key studio lighting with a front-left key, wrap fill and single-direction soft contact shadows, one small controlled specular on wet balm, no harsh speculars; modern geometric sans-serif throughout with a bold uppercase headline over a lighter thin sub-line; thin single-weight line icons inside blank rounded chips and three-dot indicator rows; soft squeeze-tube products shown upright and stable at consistent scale with the label face to camera; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no brand wordmark or source packaging art
no numeric claims inside graphic rows
style.presentationRules: soft squeeze tube kept upright at a stable scale with the cap end down and the label face to camera, one new camera angle per screen, glossy balm sweep used only as a texture prop, no packaging artwork redraw
style.surfaceSystem: matte seamless paper sweep and smooth blush laminate plates #F2D9D5 and #FDF2F0, no stone or wood grain, no mirror reflection
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif only, bold uppercase headline over a lighter thin sub-line, left-aligned copy column, wide line spacing, every wording supplied as a blank placeholder slot
